tha-ap51:1.1: Subhadda.] Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / janataṃ uddharitvāna nibbāyati mahāyaso. // //
tha-ap51:2.1: Nibbāyante ca sambuddhe dasasahassī pakampatha / janakāyo mahā āsi devā sannipatuṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap51:3.1: Candanaṃ pūrayitvāna tagaramallikāhi ca / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena ālepesiṃ naruttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap51:4.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro / nipannako ca sambuddho imā gāthā abhāsathā: // //
tha-ap51:5.1: Yo me pacchimake kāle gandhamālena chādayi / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap51:6.1: ‘Ito cuto ayaṃ poso Tusitakāyaṃ gamissati / tattha rajjaṃ karitvāna Nimmānaṃ so gamissati. // //
tha-ap51:7.1: Eten' eva upāyena datvā malyaṃ varuttamaṃ / sakakammābhiraddho so sampattiṃ anubhossati. // //
tha-ap51:8.1: Cuto pi Tusite kāye nibbattissati 'yaṃ naro / tamhā kāyā cavitvāna manussattaṃ gamissati. // //
tha-ap51:9.1: Sakyaputto mahānāgo aggo loke sadevake / bodhayitvā bahū satte nibbāyissati cakkhumā. // //
tha-ap51:10.1: Pabbajjūpagato santo sukkamūlena codito / upasaṅkammā sambuddhaṃ pañhaṃ pucchissate tadā. // //
tha-ap51:11.1: Bhāsayitvāna sambuddho sabbaññū lokanāyako / pubbaṃ kammaṃ abhiññāya saccāni vivarissati. // //
tha-ap51:12.1: Āraddho ca ayaṃ pañho tuṭṭho ekaggamānaso / satthāraṃ abhivādetvā pabbajjaṃ yācayissati. // //
tha-ap51:13.1: Pasannamānasaṃ disvā sakakammena tositaṃ / pabbajessati so Buddho aggadhammassa kovido. // //
tha-ap51:14.1: Vāyamitvāna yaṃ poso sammāsambuddhasāsane, / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap51:16.1: Pubbakammena saṃyutto ekaggo susamāhito / Buddhassa oraso putto dhammajo 'mhi sunimmito. // //
tha-ap51:17.1: Dhammarājaṃ upāgantvā āpucchiṃ pañham uttamaṃ / kathayanto ca me pañhaṃ dhammasotaṃ upānayi. // //
tha-ap51:18.1: Tassāhaṃ dhammam aññāya vihāsiṃ sāsane rato / sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap51:19.1: Satasahasse ito kappe Jalajuttamanāyako / nibbāyi anupādāno dīpo va telasaṅkhayā. // //
tha-ap51:20.1: Sattayojanikaṃ āsi thūpañ ca ratanāmayaṃ / dhajaṃ tattha apūjesiṃ sabbabhaddaṃ manoramaṃ. // //
tha-ap51:21.1: Kassapassa ca sambuddhassa Tisso nām' aggasāvako / putto me oraso āsi dāyādo jinasāsane. // //
tha-ap51:22.1: Tassa hīnena manasā vācaṃ bhāsiṃ abhaddakaṃ / tena kammavipākena pacchime addasaṃ jinaṃ. // //
tha-ap51:23.1: Upavattane Sālavane pacchime sayane muni / pabbājesi mahāvīro hito kāruṇiko jino. // //
tha-ap51:24.1: Ajj' eva dāni pabbajjā ajj' eva upasampadā / ajj' eva parinibbānaṃ sammukhā dipaduttame. // //
tha-ap51:25.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ sambuddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap51:26.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Subhaddo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
